label: R&B and soul
why: R&B sits in a warm, close room with lush vocal stacks spread in an arc around a centred lead.

objects.name: lead_vocal
objects.why: The lead vocal stays where the artist put it, front and centre, and never moves.

objects.name: vocal_stack
objects.why: Stacks spread in an arc, lifting in choruses.

objects.name: percussion
objects.why: Percussion breathes slowly across the front.

objects.name: bass
objects.why: Above the crossover the bass stays centred and close; below it the original passes untouched.

objects.name: keys_guitar
objects.why: Keys and guitar in front, wide.

objects.name: room
objects.why: A warm room through the bed.

_about: Genre template (decision 0017). Azimuths in degrees, positive to the LEFT (SOFA convention), elevation up, distances in metres. spread is the angle between the object's two virtual sources; wide gives the spread and elevation it opens to in open sections. motion paths: orbit (a full turn per period when depth is 360), sway (back and forth by depth degrees), scaled by the listener's motion depth and capped at 45 degrees per second. protected objects never move.
